subject.title: [Feature]: Capture reusable techniques from successful agent work

question: Should opt-in Skill Workshop autonomy ask the active agent to infer reusable techniques from successful nontrivial work before its final reply?
rationale: Source establishes the feature gap and a safe existing proposal boundary, but the inference threshold and use of final-turn agent attention determine product behavior, latency, and false-positive tolerance.

options.title: Adopt conservative capture
options.body: Accept the linked approach with strict abstention rules, pending-only proposals, no new setting, and no second model pass.

options.title: Keep explicit signals only
options.body: Retain current capture from user instructions and corrections, leaving successful-work learning to manual skill-drafting requests.

recommendation.title: Adopt conservative capture
recommendation.body: Accept the linked approach with strict abstention rules, pending-only proposals, no new setting, and no second model pass.
